test.title: A time when you got lost

document.cue: Describe a time when you got lost.

text: I'd like to describe the time I got lost in Istanbul during a family holiday about three years ago. We'd just arrived, and I went out on my own in the evening to buy some water, thinking the shop was just around the corner from our hotel.

The problem was that the old part of the city is a maze of narrow streets that all look similar, and many of them go up and down hills. After ten minutes I realised I had no idea where I was. My phone had almost no battery, and I hadn't written down the name of the hotel.

At first I tried to retrace my steps, but that only made things worse. In the end I went into a small bakery and showed the owner a photo of the hotel entrance that I luckily had on my phone. He didn't speak much English, but he recognised it immediately, closed the shop for five minutes and walked me all the way back.

I was terrified at the time, but looking back, I'm grateful it happened. It taught me to always carry the hotel's address and a charged phone. And more importantly, it showed me how kind strangers can be when you really need help.
Whenever I travel now, the first thing I do is take a photo of the hotel sign.
